techniques.evidence: src/components/app/modules/ProjectDangerZone.tsx:31 The confirm string is the project name; PROJECT_STORE_DELETERS is not counted or classified before DELETE.

pairs.registryProposal: cascade-design's schema-declaration rule has no form for a Firestore collection and a sqlite mirror that must share one delete door; an application registry is the only door both backends actually pass through.

techniques.evidence: src/components/app/twin/useTwinState.ts:63 Untrain fires DELETE on one click and ignores the body; voices, facts, drafts and the archive are not enumerated first.

src/lib/twin/archive-store.firestore.ts:65 After the cap delete the surviving tally keeps id and archivedAt; the draft's contact and reply are not copied onto it.
